# Compiles po/<lang>/<domain>.po to share/locale/<lang>/LC_MESSAGES/<domain>.mo
#   packarch-spider.po       - the game strings (from the KDE translators of KPatience)
#   packarch-spider-extra.po - standard strings formerly provided by KDE Frameworks,
#                              generated by tools/update-extra-translations.py
find_program(MSGFMT_EXECUTABLE msgfmt)
if(NOT MSGFMT_EXECUTABLE)
    message(WARNING "msgfmt not found (package gettext): translations will not be built")
    return()
endif()

file(GLOB _po_files RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*/packarch-spider.po
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*/packarch-spider-extra.po)
set(_mo_files)
foreach(_po ${_po_files})
    get_filename_component(_lang ${_po} DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(_domain ${_po} NAME_WLE)
    set(_mo ${KPAT_BUILD_LOCALEDIR}/${_lang}/LC_MESSAGES/${_domain}.mo)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${_mo}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${KPAT_BUILD_LOCALEDIR}/${_lang}/LC_MESSAGES
        COMMAND ${MSGFMT_EXECUTABLE} --check-format -o ${_mo} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_po}
        DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_po}
        COMMENT "Compiling translation ${_lang}/${_domain}"
        VERBATIM
    )
    install(FILES ${_mo} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LOCALEDIR}/${_lang}/LC_MESSAGES)
    list(APPEND _mo_files ${_mo})
endforeach()

add_custom_target(translations ALL DEPENDS ${_mo_files})
